text: Win-builder R-devel round 1: 2 ERRORs / 1 WARN / 2 NOTEs. Real issues fixed (commit a07ae1b): U+21D2 in genpls/rpls roxygen broke PDF manual (replaced with ASCII, Rd2pdf verified locally); transfer round-trip test 1e-8 too tight for win-builder BLAS (2.2e-6 observed; relaxed to 1e-5 with comment); matrixStats added to Suggests (multivarious::standardize needs it; 4 pca-equivalence tests were silently skipping). Spurious: 'cc not on path' compiled-code NOTE is win-builder infrastructure; DESCRIPTION 'misspelled' words are author names (Abdi, Grosenick). Resubmitted to win-builder R-devel. Still awaiting: win-release + mac-release results from round 1 (they check the OLD tarball - treat only the devel resubmission as canonical for these fixes).
